summary.headline: HanWool Semiconductor: Largest shareholder pledges 20.68% stake; total pledged debt KRW 6.38bn
summary.what_happened: HanWool Semiconductor, Inc. filed a corrected disclosure (dated Nov 23, 2026) for a share pledge agreement involving its largest shareholder, Hanul Materials Science Co., Ltd. The correction reflects a partial repayment of debt, reducing the total borrowed amount from KRW 6,499,998,300 to KRW 6,376,816,500 and the total secured amount from KRW 8,449,997,790 to KRW 8,289,861,450. The largest shareholder holds 1,430,000 shares, and two share pledge contracts have been entered into to date.

key_numbers.label: Largest shareholder's stake (as of filing date)
Pledge contract signed (latest individual contract, per filing)
key_numbers.value: Nov 12, 2026 end of pledge period (Sep 7, 2026 for second contract)

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, a largest shareholder pledging shares as loan collateral is generally disclosed so investors can see that a portion of the controlling stake is encumbered; if the borrower defaults, the lender may enforce the pledge, which can in some cases shift control. Corrections like this one typically indicate changes in the outstanding loan balance rather than a new transaction.
